description: The Burgos collection combines source-described products from one mobile-mapping recording. Motion data contain 227,829 GeoJSON points with timestamps, speed, velocity, orientation and IMU components. A companion route trace defines the vehicle path, feature samples describe shoulder width, longitudinal gradient and superelevation, and a ground-truth LAS point-cloud sample supports geometry assessment. Components are grouped as related outputs, without summing their counts or claiming sample-level correspondence. The route title mentions GPX but its description specifies GeoJSON, which is retained. The exact survey date, geographic footprint and independent sample counts are unknown. All components are restricted. The named source creators provide this metadata through Zenodo, whose deposits declare CC BY 4.0. Access restrictions and underlying provider terms remain separate from that declaration; cost is unknown unless explicitly stated. Geographic and temporal coverage are limited to the source-described roads, scenarios or periods. Metadata only was reviewed, with no files, measurements, imagery, archives or document bodies downloaded. Related components retain their distinct native identities and possible overlap. The described physical assets, observations or simulator outputs support road infrastructure simulation within these stated limits.
